basic_info.description: Beautiful Contemporary Condo in the coveted Inner Sunset neighborhood! The bright and spacious full-floor flat is located in an intimate, 3-unit building and boasts a flexible open layout with expansive West facing windows. The home features a living room with electric fireplace, a dining area, a gorgeously remodeled kitchen with S/S Bosch appliances, a modern guest bath, two well-appointed bedrooms and a sizable primary suite with luxurious en-suite bath, double closets and walk out deeded deck. There is also a stacked Maytag W/D in-unit, one car deeded parking, additional storage, common shared yard and roof deck with views of Sutro Tower/Twin Peaks, the ocean and more. Low HOA dues! Nestled between 19th Avenue and 9th Avenue shopping corridors, it is conveniently located close to the N-Judah, Golden Gate Park, Andronico's, schools, parks, shopping, world class museums and all other consumer conveniences. 98 Walk Score!
